questions.question: How can you pilot a deep-space Rocketship game using hand movements?
options: By mapping the vertical Y height of your palm to the rocket's Y coordinate in a loop
questions.explanation: Correct! Mapping palm height coordinate to spaceship coordinate lets players steer by waving hands vertically.

questions.question: Which gesture can trigger laser weapon fires in a hand-controlled space simulator?
options: A rapid hand clap (sensing palms touching or distance < 50 pixels)
questions.explanation: Excellent! Measuring relative palm coordinate distances triggers action events (like weapons) on proximity benchmarks.

questions.question: What is Air Painting?
options: Painting the walls of your room
Drawing continuous glowing lines on a virtual stage canvas by waving your fingers in the air in front of a webcam!
questions.explanation: Perfect! Air Painting uses hand tracking coordinates to trail drawings onto stage canvases without paintbrushes.

questions.question: Which finger joint coordinates are mapped to draw paths on the canvas in an Air Painter?
questions.explanation: Spot on! The index fingertip coordinates act as the virtual crayon tip on the canvas grid.

questions.question: How do you start drawing in Air Painter (pen down) versus moving without drawing (pen up)?
options: Use pinch gestures: pen down when fingers pinch, pen up when fingers separate!
questions.explanation: Great! Pinch gestural checks toggle the virtual pen down and up, creating authentic touchless drawing states.

questions.question: Which block from the Pen extension draws paths behind a moving sprite?
questions.explanation: Perfect! The 'pen down' block tells the sprite to drag its virtual ink across coordinates.

questions.question: Which block stops a sprite from drawing lines as it moves?
questions.explanation: Spot on! The 'pen up' block lifts the virtual marker off the canvas, stopping paths.

questions.question: What block wipes out the air-drawn doodles on your canvas, resetting your screen?
questions.explanation: Great! 'erase all' wipes the drawing layer clean instantly.

questions.question: What happens to the rocket speed variable in our game if we wave our hand extremely rapidly upward?
options: We can increase speed by calculating height changes between ticks, creating kinetic steering!
questions.explanation: Excellent! Dynamic coordinate shifts map to game velocity variables, elevating speeds proportional to motion.

questions.question: Why do we combine hand tracking coordinates with standard block loops?
options: To continually update coordinates, ensuring smooth, real-time responsive cursor actions
questions.explanation: Perfect! Continuous sensing loops track movements frame-by-frame, keeping interactions fluid.

questions.question: Coding Task: Write block pseudo-code to paint a trail behind your finger if pinch is detected: if hand pinching then pen down, else pen up.
questions.task_hint: if is hand pinching? then pen down else pen up
questions.explanation: Outstanding! Toggling pen states using pinch checks is the fundamental rule to paint in mid-air!

questions.question: Coding Task: Write block pseudo-code to erase all drawings and reset a scoreboard variable named 'Doodles' to 0 when space is pressed.
questions.task_hint: when space key pressed -> erase all -> set Doodles to 0
questions.explanation: Perfect! This simple script binds canvas wipes and value clears to quick event keytriggers!
